# Logichem Control (Pty) Ltd

> Electrical, control and instrumentation engineering company based in Lonehill,
> Sandton, Johannesburg, South Africa. Established 1990 — over three decades of
> industrial project delivery in 34 countries.

## About

Logichem Control provides electrical, control and instrumentation engineering
for industrial plants, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to client
specifications. The company is vendor-independent: it selects the best
equipment for each project without supplier bias, rather than relying on
pre-existing solutions. It is known for quality workmanship, competitive
pricing and transparency.

## Services

- Electrical engineering — power, control and field infrastructure for industrial plants
- Control engineering — PLC, SCADA and automation systems
- Instrumentation engineering — selection and integration of industrial instrumentation

## Industries

- Automation
- Biochem plants
- Power plants
- Process plants
- Ventilation and cooling

## Countries served

South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Zimbabwe, Mauritius, Tanzania, Uganda,
Ethiopia, Eritrea, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Gabon, Zambia, Ivory Coast,
Mali, Liberia, Ghana, Turkey, Hungary, Croatia, Norway, Lithuania, Russia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan,
Kyrgyzstan, United Arab Emirates, Iran, Singapore, Australia, Brazil, Chile,
Peru, Colombia, Guyana.
